WorkflowsBrew 5 · French press

Land a job

Run a job search without inventing credentials: see your resume the way recruiters screen it, write the tailored version, then manage the applications.

The steps, in order.

  1. Step 1

    Recruiter Lens Reviews resumes, CVs and LinkedIn profiles the way recruiters actually screen them: first-impression scans, ATS compatibility, rejection-pattern diagnosis, and interview prep. 13 commands through 5 filters, and it never invents a metric. v1.0.0

  2. Step 2

    Applicant Kit Writes the better version: decoded job description, tailored resume, bullets rewritten as action-task-result-impact, honest keyword placement, five summaries, a LinkedIn rewrite and twenty interview answers, all built from real experience. recruiter-lens judges; applicant-kit produces. Nothing invented. v1.0.0

  3. Step 3

    Application Pilot Runs the job search around the applications: turns role criteria into a live shortlist, scores each role for fit with evidence, keeps a reviewable tracker with submission and follow-up dates, flags roles that have gone quiet, drafts the follow-up and the interview briefing, and reads the funnel weekly. applicant-kit writes the packet; application-pilot keeps the search alive. It never submits anything, and never claims a status it did not see. v1.0.1

  4. Step 4 · optional

    Career Track For the moves around a career: a positioning line you can repeat, the case for the next level, review and promotion narratives, salary negotiation scripts and a ninety-day plan. v1.0.0

It never submits an application for you.

Install the whole workflow.

npx skills add arm-pz/recruiter-lens                               # step 1
npx skills add arm-pz/applicant-kit --skill applicant-kit          # step 2
npx skills add arm-pz/application-pilot --skill application-pilot  # step 3
npx skills add arm-pz/career-track                                 # step 4, optional

In Claude Code you can take every skill at once instead: /plugin marketplace add arm-pz/caffeinity-skills, then /plugin install caffeinity@caffeinity-skills. Not sure this is the right workflow? Install caffeinity-routing and describe the outcome; it picks one.
